notes.title: Update Notes V1.2
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Small update, here are the things that have changed from the previous version.

[h3]Changelog:[/h3]

[list]
[*]Changed the Tool Tip to now show what can be done with the item that is being hovered.
[*]Removed Room Items, making it easier for you to customize into your own room.
[/list]

We're still working on getting the UI looking better, nothing has been implemented this time around other than the ToolTip.

notes.title: Update Notes V1.1
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Mid week update here.
I hope you're all enjoying the sweet new tunes that Yellow Cherry Jam has let us use within the game, don't forget, if you already haven't go check out their [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCgVluuSHXrsVZr8iKWpy4bQ]YouTube[/url] and [url=https://yellowcherryjam.bandcamp.com/]Bandcamp[/url], they make amazing music and are amazing people.

[h3]Changelog: [/h3]

[list]
[*] We've added a building cupboard beside the bed, this now allows you to place items inside the room to make it a little more lively and unique.
[/list]

More items will be added to the building menu over time, we're still trying to sort out a few kinks here and there, if you find any make sure to let us know. We've tried hard to remove them but some do slip through.

[h3]Upcoming:[/h3]

Nothing too major will be upcoming within the next few patches, they'll mainly be around bug fixes and additional items to build.

The next major patch that we're working towards though is the UI. We've received some feedback on this and we're starting to rework it and make it a little more friendly for users to use.

notes.title: Update Notes V1.0
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

Good News!! 
We have some new music!

I would like to thank Yellow Cherry Jam for allowing us to use some of their songs within the game.
We came across them one day on [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCgVluuSHXrsVZr8iKWpy4bQ]YouTube [/url]and fell in love with their music. It's lovely to hear and see some non-AI generated tunes. Make sure you check them out on [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCgVluuSHXrsVZr8iKWpy4bQ]YouTube [/url]& [url=https://yellowcherryjam.bandcamp.com/]Bandcamp[/url]. Also, they have a very beautiful puppy that you can watch while you listen and watch them make music.

[h3]Changelog:[/h3]

[list]
[*]New Music by Yellow Cherry Jam
[*]Majority of the game has been rewritten to be better optimized
[/list]


[h3]Upcoming:[/h3]

We were supposed to be including a big content update this time around but we will be adding it later this week as we're making sure there are no to little bugs.

Thank you all for your support and everything!

notes.title: Update Notes V0.1.3
notes.content:
Hi All,

This will hopefully be the final optimization fix. There’s nothing major in terms of new content in this build, as most of the additions are groundwork for the next patch.

[h3]Changelog:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Groundwork for next patch
[*] Optimization
[/list]

There won't be any updates for a couple of weeks as the next patch will include new content and songs.

notes.title: Update Notes V0.1.2
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Here’s another update! We’ll aim to keep these coming weekly as we continue to optimize the game as much as we can.

[h3]Changelog:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced plant timers to improve CPU performance
[*] Adjusted interactions: cleaning, feeding, and collecting dead fish
[*] Tweaked plant watering durations for better balance
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes V0.1.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Here’s the first update! We plan to update the game regularly, adding new features and refining existing ones. This update mainly focuses on performance improvements, so the game should now run more smoothly for those who experienced issues.

[h3]Changelog:[/h3]
[list]

[*]Fish can now be collected when they are dead in the tank.

[*]FPS has been locked to 60 to reduce GPU usage.

[*]Updated game icon.

[*]Anti-aliasing and shadows have been adjusted to reduce GPU usage.
[/list]
